verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly claim auto-receipt capture at card swipe with AI-filled memos/categories, plus automatic transaction categorization synced to ERP without manual entry, and AI agents documented to handle auto-coding as a core capability. This is corroborated by broader AI-agent/automation architecture (audit logs, agent identity, CLI/MCP tooling) showing the coding pipeline is real infrastructure, not just marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user confirmation specifically of receipt-capture-at-swipe accuracy (community comments are about expense card issuance/travel comp, not receipt OCR/coding specifically).
